question: Arjun sells two cycles for ₹600 each. On one he makes a profit of 50% and on the other a loss of 50%. What is his overall profit or loss percentage?

solutionHi: समान विक्रय मूल्य और समान % लाभ-हानि पर सदा (50²/100)% = 25% हानि होती है। (क्रय मूल्य: ₹400 और ₹1,200।)
